title: Ecosystem knowledge schema: components, standards, protocols, versions, relations
goal: Define the schema (entities: component, vendor, standard, protocol, spec-version, capability; typed relations) as JSON Schema plus a Rust validator, so susi holds a structured model of the cloud AI ecosystem instead of scattered constants. Facts come from official machine-readable specs or cited primary sources (no scraping that violates terms); every fact carries source, spec version, retrieved date and confidence.
